deployment_order.name: SNAPSHOT
deployment_order.action: Capture current registry R_t, environment state e_t, bound arguments B_t, user goal g_t and model checkpoint h_t.

deployment_order.name: COMPILE_DOMAIN
deployment_order.action: For every candidate tool, deterministically evaluate registry membership, required bindings, schema/types, permissions and environment preconditions. Build executable subset U_t.

deployment_order.name: ADD_CONTROL_ACTIONS
deployment_order.action: Always add ASK, WAIT, ABSTAIN and CONTINUE candidates. Add CALL_SET when the goal has multiple independent executable subgoals.

deployment_order.name: SCORE
deployment_order.action: Using one common scoring convention, compute Q for every admissible action. Recommended: constrained continuation log-probability or a separately trained action-value head.

deployment_order.name: DIFFERENTIATE
deployment_order.action: Backprop each action score to the chosen internal checkpoint h_t; save g_a=dQ_a/dh_t.

deployment_order.name: LOCATE_BOUNDARY
deployment_order.action: Let a* be top action and b* runner-up. Compute M=Q(a*)-Q(b*) and rho=M/||g_a*-g_b*||.

deployment_order.name: ROBUSTNESS_GATE
deployment_order.action: Compare rho with clean calibrated threshold for the winner action kind. Below threshold: HOLD_UNSTABLE; do not execute a consequential tool.

deployment_order.name: DECIDE
deployment_order.action: CALL->EXECUTE; CALL_SET->EXECUTE_SET; ASK->request missing information; WAIT->report/request missing capability; ABSTAIN->no tool; CONTINUE->allow another reasoning step.

deployment_order.name: ARGUMENT_SUBCHECK
deployment_order.action: Before execution, repeat the same margin/radius check for every content-bearing argument value or use schema-constrained decoding plus per-slot confidence/radius.

deployment_order.name: EXECUTION_GUARD
deployment_order.action: Outside the model, revalidate name, arguments, permission, scope and side-effect policy. The model cannot bypass this guard.

deployment_order.name: POST_RESULT_RESET
deployment_order.action: Treat tool result as a new observation; update e_t/B_t/R_t and recompute readiness from scratch. Never inherit the previous CALL decision automatically.

deployment_order.name: TRACE_AUDIT
deployment_order.action: Log every state. If a robust CALL was reached and a later CONTINUE step exits CALL while hard CALL admissibility stayed true, emit TOOL_OVERTHINKING_EXIT.

deployment_order.name: CALIBRATE
deployment_order.action: Build clean radius distributions per model/task/tool-family. Start with p01 as warning floor; tighten for consequential tools.

deployment_order.name: REGRESSION
deployment_order.action: Replay BFCL simple/multiple/irrelevance/parallel/missing-param/missing-function plus injection/hallucination cases after any model, prompt, registry or schema change.

production_rule: Hard domain guard is mandatory. Readiness geometry decides when/how to act inside the hard domain; it never replaces registry/schema/permission enforcement.
debug_rule: If a wrong action is robust, hand the state to Failure Axis Guard OS and run activation patch/transplant to localize the semantic mis-selection mechanism.
